Interactive Smart Board:  
All classrooms in the department are equipped with Teachmint X smart boards, enabling faculty 
to deliver lectures using multimedia elements such as images, videos, animations, and interactive 
simulations. Faculty use software like Teachmint to capture lecture content, including annotations and 
multimedia, which can be converted into PDF format for distribution. PDFs are shared with students via 
the Teachmint app, ensuring accessibility for all students, including those absent from class. Faculty can 
integrate real-time quizzes, diagrams, or live coding demonstrations, fostering active participation.  
The Teachmint X Smart Board is a next -generation classroom solution designed to enhance 
teaching effectiveness, student engagement, and classroom collaboration. Equipped with AI capabilities, 
a 4K UHD display, and seamless Google integration, it simplifies the teaching process while delivering 
an enriched learning experience.  
Modern Operating System and Google Ecosystem Integration  
Comes with:  
 Google Play Store access  
 Google Play Protect  
 Google Classroom App integration
